description: Three classification tasks over 800 product descriptions that cross 80 products x 5 registers x 2 paraphrase variants. The tasks are designed to dissociate semantic content (what a description is about) from surface register (how it is written), for probing transformer representations.

register.question: Which linguistic register is this description written in?
register.notes: Surface-form task. Trivially solvable from the token distribution alone (probe F1 = 1.0 at the embedding layer). Use as the 'form' axis.

category.question: Which product category does this description describe?
category.notes: Coarse-content task. Saturates early (probe F1 ~= 0.99 by layer 20). Use as the 'coarse content' axis.

product.question: Which specific product (one of 80) does this description describe?
product.notes: Fine-grained content task. 40 real + 40 fictional products, 10 per category (5 real + 5 fictional). The fictional half is a memorization control: any clustering there cannot come from pretraining associations.

recommended_protocol.representation: Mean-pool the residual-stream hidden state across non-special token positions (exclude BOS/EOS/PAD) at the layer of interest, giving one 5120-d vector per stimulus per layer.
recommended_protocol.dimensionality_reduction: PCA to 200 components per layer before probe training (used in the reference baselines).

cross_validation.rationale: Keeps both variants of a product in the same fold to prevent paraphrase leakage. NOTE: for the 80-class product task this makes test classes unseen (zero-shot) -> F1=0 by construction. For a within-product generalization test, use StratifiedKFold over (product_id, variant) instead and report it separately.

controls.label_permutation: Train one control probe per task on a class-size-preserving random label permutation (Hewitt & Manning 2019); report selectivity = real_F1 - control_F1.
controls.bag_of_words_ceiling: Report a TF-IDF + logistic regression baseline; all three tasks hit 100% with BoW, so neural results must be read against that ceiling.

rsa_models.description: Theoretical RDMs to correlate (Spearman) against the observed cosine RDM at each layer.
